equip_instructions: Pick a pack by pack_id (zooted-zone-pack, shaka-zulu-pack, doves-diamonds-pack, diabolique-pack) — or author your own against https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/final-cut/final-cut-schema.json
Check the gate: truth_gate_report.status must be 'pass' with at least one claims_verified entry naming a fact source. A pack without a passing report is a rejected package — do not post it.

POST the unit: copy content.caption / content.threads_text / content.hashtags to your platform target (platform_targets lists which the unit is formatted for). No auth, no scheduling queue — a publishing instrument, not a calendar.
Brand rule: the CWI logo badge ships on every visual asset. Every pack's media_files pair official release art with the CWI badge.

item.description: The Marketing department's truth-gated content.json publishing units — product #16 of the Agent Deck gear line. Ready-to-post content packages an agent can PUBLISH in seconds: every package ships as machine-readable content.json and every claim inside is truth-gated against the verified CWI fact set before the package is issued. Ships with launch packs for That Boy Hi Hat tracks (Zooted Zone, Shaka Zulu, Doves & Diamonds, Diabolique). Beats Hootsuite/Buffer/Later: the content comes WITH the verified facts, not just scheduling. Free.
